user.title: Connect to EMMASA Portal Ciudadano
user.description: Enter your EMMASA Oficina Virtual credentials to import hourly water consumption and billing summaries.

select_contract.title: Select water supply contract
select_contract.description: Your EMMASA account has {count} water supply contracts. Select the contract you want to monitor in this Home Assistant entry. You can repeat setup later to add additional supplies.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EMMASA
reauth_confirm.description: Your EMMASA session for account {username} has expired or was rejected. Please enter your password again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EMMASA credentials
reconfigure.description: Update your EMMASA Oficina Virtual credentials without removing existing entities or history.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to EMMASA servers. Please try again later.
error.contract_not_found: The configured water supply contract is no longer associated with this EMMASA account.
error.invalid_contract: The selected water supply contract is not valid.
error.mfa_required: This EMMASA account requires SMS multi-factor authentication, which is not currently supported.
error.password_change_required: EMMASA requires a password change in the Oficina Virtual web portal before signing in.
error.no_contracts: No water supply contracts were found for this EMMASA account.

abort.already_configured: This EMMASA water supply contract is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new credentials do not match the configured EMMASA water supply contract.

init.title: EMMASA polling and history options
init.description: Adjust how often Home Assistant polls EMMASA and how many days of hourly history to import (increasing this value automatically backfills older available history).

auth_failed.message: Authentication with EMMASA failed. Please reauthenticate the integration.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to reach EMMASA servers during setup.

contract_not_found.message: The configured EMMASA water supply contract was not found in this account.

update_failed.message: Error updating EMMASA water consumption data: {error}
